simple, no dimensions.sql:
SELECT
  SUM("t0"."principal_amount") AS "disbursement_amount"
FROM "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t0"
WHERE
  (
    NOT "t0"."disbursement_date" IS NULL
  )
LIMIT 1000

simple, region, month, range.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."disbursement_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
  "t1"."region_name" AS "branch__region_name",
  SUM("t0"."principal_amount") AS "disbursement_amount"
FROM "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t0"
LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t1"
  ON "t0"."booking_branch_id" = "t1"."branch_id"
WHERE
  (
    NOT "t0"."disbursement_date" IS NULL
  )
  AND "t0"."disbursement_date" >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND "t0"."disbursement_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."disbursement_date") AS DATE),
  "t1"."region_name"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "branch__region_name"
LIMIT 1000

balance by region.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
  "t2"."region_name" AS "branch__region_name",
  SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal"
FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
  ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
  ON "t1"."servicing_branch_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
WHERE
  (
    COALESCE("t0"."days_past_due", 0) <= 210
  )
  AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)
  AND "t0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
    SELECT
      MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
    FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
    WHERE
      "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)
      AND "s0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
    GROUP BY
      CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
  )
GROUP BY
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
  "t2"."region_name"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "branch__region_name"
LIMIT 1000

ratio by region.sql:
WITH "m_npf_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."region_name" AS "branch__region_name",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "npf_outstanding_principal"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."servicing_branch_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."days_past_due" > 90
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE("t0"."days_past_due", 0) <= 210
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      WHERE
        "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)
        AND "s0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."region_name"
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."region_name" AS "branch__region_name",
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."branches" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."servicing_branch_id" = "t2"."branch_id"
  WHERE
    (
      COALESCE("t0"."days_past_due", 0) <= 210
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
      WHERE
        "s0"."snapshot_date" >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)
        AND "s0"."snapshot_date" < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
      GROUP BY
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "s0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', "t0"."snapshot_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."region_name"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__region_name",
    "npf_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "m_npf_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__region_name",
    NULL AS "npf_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "m_outstanding_principal"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "branch__region_name",
    COALESCE(MAX("npf_outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "npf_outstanding_principal",
    COALESCE(MAX("outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "branch__region_name"
)
SELECT
  "metric_time",
  "branch__region_name",
  "npf_outstanding_principal",
  "outstanding_principal",
  CAST("npf_outstanding_principal" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("outstanding_principal", 0) AS "npf_ratio"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "branch__region_name"
LIMIT 1000

ratio with filter.sql:
WITH "m_collected_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."posting_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."financing_scheme" AS "product__financing_scheme",
    SUM("t0"."principal_paid" + "t0"."interest_paid") AS "collected_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."payments" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."products" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."product_id" = "t2"."product_id"
  WHERE
    (
      NOT "t0"."is_reversed"
    ) AND "t2"."product_category" IN ('car_backed')
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."posting_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."financing_scheme"
), "m_due_amount" AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."due_date") AS DATE) AS "metric_time",
    "t2"."financing_scheme" AS "product__financing_scheme",
    SUM("t0"."installment_amount") AS "due_amount"
  FROM "lending"."core"."installment_schedules" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."contracts" AS "t1"
    ON "t0"."contract_id" = "t1"."contract_id"
  LEFT JOIN "lending"."core"."products" AS "t2"
    ON "t1"."product_id" = "t2"."product_id"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."is_current"
    ) AND "t2"."product_category" IN ('car_backed')
  GROUP BY
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "t0"."due_date") AS DATE),
    "t2"."financing_scheme"
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "product__financing_scheme",
    "collected_amount",
    NULL AS "due_amount"
  FROM "m_collected_amount"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "product__financing_scheme",
    NULL AS "collected_amount",
    "due_amount"
  FROM "m_due_amount"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    "metric_time",
    "product__financing_scheme",
    COALESCE(MAX("collected_amount"), 0) AS "collected_amount",
    COALESCE(MAX("due_amount"), 0) AS "due_amount"
  FROM "unioned"
  GROUP BY
    "metric_time",
    "product__financing_scheme"
)
SELECT
  "metric_time",
  "product__financing_scheme",
  "collected_amount",
  "due_amount",
  CAST("collected_amount" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("due_amount", 0) AS "collection_rate"
FROM "combined"
ORDER BY
  "metric_time",
  "product__financing_scheme"
LIMIT 1000

ratio with no dimensions.sql:
WITH "m_par30_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "par30_outstanding_principal"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      "t0"."days_past_due" > 30
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE("t0"."days_past_due", 0) <= 210
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
    )
), "m_outstanding_principal" AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("t0"."outstanding_principal") AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "t0"
  WHERE
    (
      COALESCE("t0"."days_past_due", 0) <= 210
    )
    AND "t0"."snapshot_date" IN (
      SELECT
        MAX("s0"."snapshot_date")
      FROM "lending"."core"."contract_monthly_snapshots" AS "s0"
    )
), "unioned" AS (
  SELECT
    "par30_outstanding_principal",
    NULL AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "m_par30_outstanding_principal"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    NULL AS "par30_outstanding_principal",
    "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "m_outstanding_principal"
), "combined" AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX("par30_outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "par30_outstanding_principal",
    COALESCE(MAX("outstanding_principal"), 0) AS "outstanding_principal"
  FROM "unioned"
)
SELECT
  "par30_outstanding_principal",
  "outstanding_principal",
  CAST("par30_outstanding_principal" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("outstanding_principal", 0) AS "par30_ratio"
FROM "combined"
LIMIT 1000

customer count by province and gender.sql:
SELECT
  "t0"."province" AS "customer__province",
  "t0"."gender" AS "customer__gender",
  COUNT(*) AS "new_customer_count"
FROM "lending"."core"."customers" AS "t0"
GROUP BY
  "t0"."province",
  "t0"."gender"
ORDER BY
  "customer__province",
  "customer__gender"
LIMIT 1000
